PLANNED SLOT ADDED - Premier EC4 Yantian to Houston, TO BE NOMINATED, 28 Sep 2026 (ISO week 40). No vessel assigned yet, so it carries no TEU and renders as TEU n/a. Recorded because an unnamed slot still signals intended deployment on the lane. Source date was reported as a Yantian arrival; the cell is stored on the 28 Sep date, which falls in week 40 either way.

FLEET CAPACITY REBASELINED - every vessel in the profile was re-checked against Flexport Atlas this run, not just the ones missing a figure. 282 of 293 vessels verified; 187 TEU values changed. The cached figures were materially wrong because they came from COSCO nominal and ONE gross-tonnage/10 estimates. Largest corrections: C HAMBURG 17649 to 8580, ZIM CANADA 3029 to 11923, CORCOVADO 2537 to 11219, MSC VITTORIA 13882 to 8089, MSC BUSAN VIII 13556 to 8089, MSC UGANDA 4688 to 8496. Atlas is now the sole authority for vesselTeu and every entry carries an imo plus asOf in vesselMeta.

SERVICE REMOVED - Premier MS2 deleted from the profile permanently. MS2 discharges at Los Angeles and moves to Houston by rail/truck, so it is not direct Asia-Gulf coverage. It was still present in the live file at the start of this run and has now been removed from alliances and serviceState.

EXTRA LOADER VERIFIED - AA9 (Asia America Service IX, Wan Hai). Rotation Port Klang - Cai Mep - Shekou - Ningbo - Qingdao - Balboa - New York - Norfolk - Charleston - Savannah. WAN HAI 712 (IMO 9965332, 7092 TEU), voyages E001 and E002. Schedule captured in full this run, so the item is now verified rather than reported. Note the rotation differs from the 20 Aug sighting - it calls Shekou and Port Klang, not Yantian, and routes via Panama. Transit Cai Mep to New York is 47 days against 30 days on AA7, so this is slow relay tonnage, not a fast extra loader.

OCEAN ALLIANCE FULLY REFRESHED - all 18 CMA routing-finder lanes returned HTTP 200 with no DataDome 403 this run. 313 direct sailings parsed. Every OA service covers the full window. Only Hong Kong carried forward, which is the known normal 0-direct result.

ZIM+MSC FULLY REFRESHED - EMPIRE, AMERICA and LONE STAR re-derived from data.json with 0 gaps. AMBERJACK and EMERALD refreshed from the MSC API, which responded normally this run after the 20 Aug outage.

PARTIAL - GEMINI CARRIED FORWARD. The Maersk point-to-point search could not be made to fire: the form accepted both locations but the Search click never issued a routings-queries request, and the renderer froze twice. No header capture was possible, so all four Gemini services (TP11/US1, TP12/US2, TP15/US3, TP16/US4) retain their 20 Aug cells.

PARTIAL - PREMIER CARRIED FORWARD. ONE Route Finder throttled after 2 lanes this run, earlier than the documented 3. Ningbo to Savannah returned 8 EC1 sailings but those rows were lost when the tab navigated. All four Premier services (EC1, EC2, EC3, EC4) retain their 20 Aug cells.

DENY-LIST UPDATED - JADE, DOLPHIN and SWAN appeared on ZIM/MSC lanes but all carry IsDirectRoute false, so they are transshipment routings and not extra loaders. Added to extraLoaders.ignoredCodes so future runs stop flagging them.

PROFORMA STATE CREATED - proformaState did not exist in the live file. It has been added for all 21 services. AA7, AMBERJACK and EMERALD carry a derived-median proforma dated today. The other 18 are marked carried-unverified with asOf null so the next run pulls the carrier-published tables (CMA flyers, ONE service-maps, ZIM point-to-point, Maersk).

VESSEL META CREATED - vesselMeta did not exist in the live file. Added with 9 entries. 7 vessels TEU-verified on Flexport Atlas this run. TACOMA MAERSK has no Atlas page and ANTWERP has a page with no TEU figure, so both are left without a TEU rather than defaulted to zero.
